subject: Three-way discovery + procurement/security triage
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@valencehealth.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T14:08:00Z
Subject: Intro + 45m discovery — availability options

Hi Lena — great to be connected. 

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. I wanted to get a 45-minute discovery on the calendar so we can:  
- Confirm use case and success metrics  
- Run a quick technical intake with our SE (Hiro) about data flows and integrations  
- Surface any procurement or security checkpoints up front so we don't get blocked later

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 2028-06-14 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2028-06-15 15:00–15:45

If neither works, feel free to pick a slot on our Calendly link below and we’ll add a short pre-read.  

Attending from our side: Aditya (AE), Mina (Customer Success lead), Hiro (SE). If procurement or security will join, please loop them in — happy to adjust agenda.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/45min-discovery?month=2028-06

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Lena Park <lena.park@valencehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@valencehealth.com>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@valencehealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T18:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + 45m discovery — availability options

Thanks, Aditya.  

Both windows are tight for our engineering lead, but Thu 2028-06-15 15:00 PT should be OK if we keep it tight and include Tim (procurement) for a quick 10-minute procurement sync at the end. Nora (security) wants to confirm that you can share a short SOC2 summary and network ingress requirements ahead of time.  

Can you attach a one-page agenda and the SOC2 highlights? If you have any requirements for test data handling, flag that too — we need to validate with our InfoSec team.

I’ll tentatively hold Thu 15:00 PT. If Tim can’t make the end-of-call procurement piece, we’ll book a follow-up.

—
Lena Park
Director, Clinical Platforms | Valence Health
lena.park@valencehealth.com

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@valencehealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T02:11:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + 45m discovery — availability options

Appreciate the notes, Lena. A couple quick clarifications from the SE side:  
- We have a short pre-read (attached) that covers ingress patterns, recommended masking for PHI-ish telemetry, and bucket-level ACLs. I’ll surface what we need for a non-prod integration during the call.
- SOC2_highlights.xlsx is attached — it’s a 1-pager of our control areas and the auditor statement. If your security team needs the full report we can coordinate an NDA-first delivery.
- For the demo, we’ll assume a sample S3-compatible feed and token-limited sample data unless you prefer a live connection. Live will take longer to validate on your side.

I’ve attached: SOC2_Highlights.xlsx, Redwood_Discovery_Agenda.pdf

—
Hiro Tanaka
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@valencehealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@valencehealth.com>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@valencehealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + 45m discovery — availability options

Thanks, all — consolidating.  

On Wed Jun 7, 2028 at 18:33, Lena Park <lena.park@valencehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Aditya.
>
> Both windows are tight for our engineering lead, but Thu 2028-06-15 15:00 PT should be OK if we keep it tight and include Tim (procurement) for a quick 10-minute procurement sync at the end. Nora (security) wants to confirm that you can share a short SOC2 summary and network ingress requirements ahead of time.

Per Hiro’s attachments (thanks Hiro) — I’ve uploaded the two items to a shared folder and attached a brief procurement checklist we typically use so Tim can scan in advance: "Procurement_Questions.docx" (stub).  

Agenda for Thu 2028-06-15 15:00 PT (45m):
- 0–10m: Introductions + success metrics (Aditya, Lena)
- 10–30m: Technical intake (Hiro) — data flow, integration constraints, demo assumptions
- 30–40m: Procurement & contract timeline (Aditya + Tim)
- 40–45m: Next steps / owners / Docs requested (Mina)

Please confirm attendees: Lena (champion), your Eng lead (if available), Tim (procurement), Nora (security) — if any of those need different times I can move the meeting.  

Calendly link (alternate slots): https://calendly.com/redwood/45min-discovery?month=2028-06
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cEXAMPLEdrive

I’ve attached: Procurement_Questions.docx (stub).

If that works I’ll send the calendar invite and include a 10-minute procurement pre-call as a separate optional block for Tim to grab after the main meeting if needed.

—
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Tim Chen <tim.chen@valencehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@valencehealth.com>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@valencehealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + 45m discovery — availability options

Confirmed for Thu 2028-06-15 15:00 PT. I’ll join the tail end for procurement. Two quick asks from procurement:  
1) Please share an estimated pricing cadence or ballpark TCO ranges we can use internally (even a one-slide note).
2) If we like the outcome, I’ll need a DocuSign-friendly SOW (one page + standard T&Cs) within 2 business days after the demo — flag if that’s a hard no.

I’ll be the procurement owner: tim.chen@valencehealth.com. If you can preload a short answer to #1 in the shared folder that’d help my internal review.

Thanks — see you Thu.

—
Tim Chen
Senior Procurement Manager | Valence Health
tim.chen@valencehealth.com
